verdicts.rationale: Milvus REST v2 API implements idempotent collection creation by design. Source code internal/rootcoord/root_coord.go line 904 explicitly logs 'create existed collection with same schema, ignore it' and returns success. Dedicated error constant errIgnoredCreateCollection (meta_table.go line 56) confirms this is intentional. The createCollectionTask.validateIfCollectionExists method (create_collection_task.go lines 532-537) checks for existing collections and returns the 'ignored' error when schemas match. Only differs from expected uniqueness semantics when schemas differ (line 535: returns error for 'create duplicate collection with different parameters'). This is well-designed idempotent API behavior, not a defect.
